runtime/random#

The native layer under random/source: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under random/source: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Portable PCG32 state and fixed-width sample interpretation.
